### Install

Download **Pro-Check-Setup.exe** below (under *Assets*) and open it. It installs in a few seconds — no administrator password — and puts **Pro-Check** on the Desktop and in the Start Menu. If an older copy is running, the installer closes it and relaunches when done.

If Windows shows a blue *"Windows protected your PC"* screen: click **More info → Run anyway**. The app is unsigned, not harmful — it just hasn't paid for a certificate, which, given the subject matter, feels period-appropriate.

Existing installs update themselves: the app downloads this version in the background and offers it with the blue ↑ button — no reinstall by hand needed. Your data, your bindings and your folders stay exactly where they were: the rename is what you see, not where things live.
